problem: Commercial property investors need a lender-ready checklist that separates property, lease, borrower, debt, equity and settlement evidence before approaching a commercial lender.

targeting.audience: Australian commercial property investors and eligible business borrowers

uniqueValue: Organises lender evidence into property, lease, borrower, debt, equity and settlement workstreams.
Adds decision guidance for short leases, valuation gaps, related-party tenancies and compressed settlement timelines.

evidence.summary: Approved rolling queue item with distinct checklist intent and commercial property ownership.
ASIC Moneysmart outlines key commercial property investment risks including finance, leases, vacancies and costs.

measurement.successRule: Evidence of non-brand impressions/clicks or assisted service-page engagement at review.
measurement.exitRule: Consolidate or noindex only after complete review evidence shows persistent low value or material intent overlap.

approval.basis: Approved under the explicit two-article daily-content automation policy after queue and intent-ownership review.
